legenda: The Alaska Marine Highway System is the National Highway System link to Juneau.
texto_para_tela: ALASKA MARINE HIGHWAY: JUNEAU'S NATIONAL HIGHWAY SYSTEM LINK
narracao: With no such road, Juneau's official highway link is the state ferry system, called the Alaska Marine Highway.

conferencia.prova: "The AMHS is the National Highway System link to Juneau, Haines, and Skagway." / "The mainline ferry routes are part of the National Highway System (NHS)."
